title: 📱 The end of 16GB RAM phones? A memory crisis could bring back 4GB phones.. and prices are set to rise!
body: 📱 The end of 16GB RAM phones? A memory crisis could bring back 4GB phones.. and prices are set to rise!

Phones with 16GB of memory could disappear during 2026, and phones with just 4GB of memory could return well beyond the budget category, according to a new leak on 20 November. The cause is a worsening global memory crisis, driven by demand from AI data centres, which is pushing up the price of memory chips and forcing companies to cut specifications to protect their profit margins.

The pressure is already showing in the numbers: phone shipments in America fell 9% in the third quarter of 2026, and rising memory costs are squeezing Android makers in particular, while companies are turning to higher prices or less memory instead of absorbing the increase alone.

What is new here is that the cuts could reach the phone's specifications themselves, not just its price. A phone with 4GB of memory in 2026 means slower apps and more switching between them, at a time when AI apps need more memory, not less — making the retreat a step backwards in an age when everything is moving forward.
Simply put: less memory in your next phone and a higher price, because data centres buy the memory before you do — will you buy your phone now, before the powerful versions disappear?
